title: nlist.len

messages.description: output nested list's length at top level (same as 0)
index of deeper levels (bang at level 0)

arguments.description: nested list name to bind to

body: [nlist.len] gets the length of a nested list. The length counts top level elements, which can be atoms, a list or a nested list on its own. You can query for lengths of deeper levels as well with floats. In this case, a series of floats is output if more than one length is found, and the index list of each is given in the right outlet. Clicking on the object opens the editor window of the [nlist.define] object with the same name.
